title: Per-slot meta.json
description: One record per slot, at data/batches/<batch>/configs/<config_id>/slots/<k>/meta.json. Records the slot terminal state (scheme §1.1 five terminal states + rate-limited-exhausted), and — only when state=valid — the L1 scalars, the data-fidelity verdict (scheme §3), telemetry, and flags. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme fixes the fidelity/L1 SEMANTICS byte-exactly but not the JSON field names; object shapes below are this contract's design, aligned field-by-field to scheme §3 / appendix A. Numeric compute values are JSON numbers here; see CONTRACT-NOTES for the determinism-serialization caveat on any file that enters a verify rehash. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. The file-level schema_version lives here (structured $comment) so the lock-population loop (DATA-LAYOUT §4) reads one uniform source across all eleven schema files. Corrected this pass per DECISIONS-M0 §1 (condition stays 4-state), §6 (slot_index required for all six terminal states), §7 (fidelity decision trace moved to fidelity-trace.json).

slot_index.description: Slot number k (matches the slots/<k>/ directory). REQUIRED for ALL SIX terminal states (DECISIONS-M0 §6 ruling, reverting the earlier scoping that removed it from rate-limited-exhausted/unreachable). Ruling model: every config × variant has N slot POSITIONS k=0..N-1; a slot is a position, and its terminal state records what happened at that position. The four model-reaching states (valid, model-failed, infra-failed, acceptance-unknown) FILL the position with a request that reached the model; unreachable and rate-limited-exhausted are the SAME positions left UNFILLED after retries exhausted (request never delivered to the model). '不占 slot' in scheme §1.1 means those retries do NOT consume cost / are NOT counted as samples (cost bound = model-reaching requests ≤ N) — it does NOT mean 'no slot record'. Therefore slot_index is a real position for all six states; L1/fidelity are null for the two unfilled (and every non-valid) state. gallery canonical slot = smallest slot_index that is valid (scheme §1.1). Attempt-level retry detail for a position (multiple 429 / not-sent tries before exhaustion) lives in the separate per-config send-log.json (DECISIONS-M0 §6).

state.description: Slot terminal state (scheme §1.1). All six are outcomes of a slot POSITION k (DECISIONS-M0 §6); slot_index is required for every one. valid = complete response + valid HTML. model-failed = complete response, no valid HTML (no retry-replace). infra-failed = vendor accepted then died mid-stream (model-reaching, consumes cost, infra-health page). acceptance-unknown = bytes sent but acceptance unprovable (model-reaching, consumes cost, may have billed). unreachable = provably-not-sent (connection refused / DNS / TLS pre-write), 5 retries exhausted — an UNFILLED position (no cost consumed, not a sample). rate-limited-exhausted = provably-uncharged pre-model refusal (429/quota/503), backoff budget exhausted — also an UNFILLED position; NOT counted as model-failed (scheme §1.1 v12.1). '不占 slot' = does not consume cost / is not a sample, NOT 'no slot record'.

fence.description: Convenience mirror of the 'fence' flag: HTML was code-fence-wrapped and stripped to a valid document (state stays valid + fence flag). Optional; authoritative flag list is 'flags'.
fence.$comment: Not in required; present only when true is meaningful. Redundant with flags[] by design for quick filtering.

flags.description: Version-locked flag set for this slot. Closed enum (scheme §2/§7 flag vocabulary). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme lists flags with a trailing '…'; this contract freezes the enum below and any new flag is a schema_version bump (keeps lock stable). Empty array = no flags.

telemetry.description: Per-slot telemetry. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): field set is this contract's design. Any value may be null when unreported. request_id/response-header presence is the evidence that distinguishes infra-failed / acceptance-unknown (scheme §1.1).

request_id.description: Vendor request id / response-header evidence, if present.

l1.description: L1 single-card descriptive scalars (scheme §3 + appendix A). MUST be a full object when state=valid, and null otherwise (enforced by the conditional at the bottom). Numeric values are JSON numbers; per CONTRACT-NOTES, files entering a verify rehash must serialize numbers deterministically.

bytes.description: Byte-size breakdown of the card document (scheme §3 'bytes 拆分'). Field split is contract design.

structure.description: DOM/CSS/JS structural counts (scheme §3). Exact counter set is contract design.

visual.description: Visual scalars per appendix A formulas (Hasler-Susstrunk colorfulness; Rec.601 brightness; population-stddev contrast ddof=0; whitespace = most-frequent 64-bin ratio; frame-change median/max from §2.3).

frame_change.description: Adjacent virtual-frame per-pixel change ratio (any channel diff>0), median and max (§2.3, appendix A).

palette_top8.description: Top-8 Lab-bin swatches: ONLY non-zero-weight bins, <=8, sort key (-weight, Lab bin C-order index) (scheme §3, v-palette appendix A). Half-open bins [lo,hi), last bin per dim closed.

fidelity.description: Data-fidelity verdict (scheme §3). MUST be a full object when state=valid, null otherwise (conditional below). Field states use the {match,mismatch,ambiguous,not-found} enum; hourly point states use {match,mismatch,not-shown}. Carries the TERMINAL verdict + scalar reason ONLY. RULED (DECISIONS-M0 §7): the full binding decision trace scheme §3/§8 mandates ('候选、显著度、绑定决策、判定路径全部落盘') lives in the SEPARATE per-slot fidelity-trace.json (schema: fidelity-trace.schema.json), NOT inline here — meta.json stays lightweight for the card page; the trace is deep-audit data. This object is the terminal-verdict summary; fidelity-trace.json is the load-bearing '全部落盘' artifact and MUST be frozen before any fidelity verdict is published (LAW).

extractor_version.description: extractor_version that produced this verdict; frozen into lock (scheme §11).

name.description: name field: any candidate contains the expected name substring -> match, else not-found. Scheme §3 is explicit: name has ONLY {match, not-found} ('无 mismatch 态') — NO mismatch, NO ambiguous. Uses the 2-state nameVerdict, NOT the general 4-state fieldVerdict. reason in {no-visible-text, text-present-no-name-hit}.

date.description: date field: parse ISO+locale templates to UTC day. hit->match, other day->mismatch, unparseable->not-found, multi-candidate conflict->ambiguous. Uses all four field states (scheme §3).

condition.description: condition field: WMO multilingual vocab text match; icon-only -> not-found + icon-only note. Uses the general 4-state fieldVerdict {match,mismatch,ambiguous,not-found}. RULED (DECISIONS-M0 §1): condition STAYS 4-state and is NOT constrained to {match,not-found}. Rationale (Fable 5): name is 2-state only because scheme §3 explicitly says name '无 mismatch 态'; condition carries no such restriction, and a displayed condition contradicting the WMO code (e.g. code=61 shown as 'Sunny') is a real mismatch signal that must not be discarded. Earlier owner-decision flag removed per this ruling.

max.description: daily max. Global one-to-one binding (scheme §3 max/min). value = canonical occurrence's matched decimal (nullable).

min.description: daily min. Same binding machinery as max.

hourly.description: hourly field: pre-triage + max-cardinality injective binding (scheme §3 hourly).

request_side.description: Request-side hard validation of the contract query from the network log (endpoint, lat/lon +/-0.01, start/end_date, daily/hourly field sets, timezone=UTC, temperature_unit=celsius) — scheme §3 请求侧硬校验.

violations.description: Per-key mismatch descriptors; empty when status=match.

state.description: General field terminal state (scheme §3 field-state enum). Used by date and condition.

reason.description: Versioned reason code (e.g. no-visible-text, text-present-no-name-hit, no-temperature-candidate, insufficient-distinct-temperature-nodes), or null.

nameVerdict.description: name-field verdict. Scheme §3 restricts name to TWO terminal states only ('无 mismatch 态'): a candidate contains the expected name substring -> match, otherwise not-found. No mismatch, no ambiguous.

state.description: name terminal state — ONLY match | not-found (scheme §3).

reason.description: Versioned reason code; scheme §3 names {no-visible-text, text-present-no-name-hit} for name, or null.
Versioned reason code (e.g. no-temperature-candidate, insufficient-distinct-temperature-nodes), or null.

value.description: Canonical decimal string of the bound canonical occurrence's displayed value, or null when no canonical published. Decimal-string to preserve displayed precision without float drift.

display_decimals.description: Displayed decimal places d used for the ROUND_HALF_UP quantize comparison (scheme §3 数值匹配), or null.

state.description: hourly FIELD state aggregation (scheme §3): structural conflict->ambiguous; no candidate->not-found; else X=#mismatch,M=#match: X>=1->mismatch; X=0&M>=1->match; X=0&M=0->not-found.

reason.description: Versioned reason / decision-path code, or null.

points.description: Per-UTC-hour point states, hour 0..23 in order. Point-state enum {match,mismatch,not-shown} (distinct from field-state enum). scheme §3 hourly.

coverage.description: Coverage M/24 persistently displayed (scheme §3). String form e.g. '18/24', or null when not applicable.
